categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the research, development, production, and sales of cosmetic raw materials, finished products, and medical devices. It also manages dual-beauty chain stores and provides related personnel training. The business covers professional skincare products for home use and professional care sets for beauty salons, targeting end consumers through multiple sales channels.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages patented extraction technologies using natural plant ingredients combined with green, environmentally friendly methods such as supercritical CO2 extraction and ultrasonic concentration. It develops bio-based carbon quantum dots, plant-derived exosome-like vesicles for skincare efficacy, and recombinant peptides to enhance skin penetration and product effectiveness. The production process includes strict quality control, ISO certifications, and GMP standards to ensure product safety and efficacy.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include professional beauty salons, distributors, and end consumers primarily in China and Taiwan. The company targets mid-to-high-end customer segments through professional salon channels, consumer sales (CS) channels, and direct-operated and franchised dual-beauty stores. The focus is on skincare and medical beauty markets, including high-end personalized facial brands and female intimate health products.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in Mainland China, Taiwan, and Hong Kong, with subsidiaries and production facilities concentrated in Fujian Province and Xiamen city in China. Over 90% of sales are in Mainland China, covering 41 provinces, cities, and autonomous regions. Taiwan and Hong Kong serve as additional markets and operational bases.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company is positioned in the midstream and downstream segments of the cosmetics industry. It develops and manufactures cosmetic raw materials and finished products, then distributes them through a network of distributors and direct retail channels to end consumers. It also operates chain stores and provides training, maintaining close relationships with upstream raw material suppliers and downstream distributors and salons.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include digital transformation integrating online and offline sales channels, expanding direct-operated and franchised stores, and developing medical beauty and bio-based raw materials. R&D focuses on innovative natural ingredient extraction, plant exosome vesicles, recombinant peptides, and personalized skincare products. The company collaborates with academic institutions and invests in advanced R&D facilities to maintain competitive advantages and comply with stricter regulatory standards.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of cosmetic raw materials, finished skincare products, and medical beauty devices. Sales channels include professional salon distributors, consumer sales channels, and direct-operated/franchised retail stores. The company also earns income from training services and brand licensing within its dual-beauty chain operations.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with both international and domestic cosmetic brands in China, with domestic brands gaining market share due to alignment with consumer preferences for herbal and natural products. It holds a modest market share (~1.17%) but benefits from strong R&D capabilities, multiple sales channels, and a growing presence in high-end and medical beauty segments. The company emphasizes product differentiation through patented technologies and quality certifications to maintain competitiveness.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In the recent fiscal year, the company reported consolidated revenue of approximately NT$2.23 billion, a 27% increase from the previous year, and a net profit of about NT$97 million, up 3%. The majority of revenue (76%) comes from Mainland China. The company maintains a healthy financial structure with a debt-to-asset ratio of 35%, a current ratio between 32-33%, and positive operating cash flow. It plans continued revenue growth supported by channel expansion and R&D investment.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes professional expertise, patented natural ingredient extraction technologies, and high-quality product safety standards to deliver differentiated skincare and medical beauty products. Its value proposition includes comprehensive product lines for both home and professional use, integration of traditional herbal knowledge with modern biotech, and personalized skincare solutions. The company also focuses on sustainable practices, regulatory compliance, and strong brand reputation to build customer trust and loyalty.
